subject.title: fix(web-search): align credential presence with usable providers

question: Should the synchronous security audit execute root-confined light public-artifact modules from installed external plugins to evaluate provider-owned configured credential hooks?
rationale: The patch has no identified correctness or loader-safety defect, but making installed external code executable from a security-audit control-plane path is a permanent trust-model choice that requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Accept guarded light modules
options.body: Allow installed external provider light artifacts during audit to preserve runtime parity for custom configured credential fields.

options.title: Require metadata-only contracts
options.body: Reject audit-time external module execution and add manifest or Plugin SDK metadata that describes provider credential semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded light modules
recommendation.body: Allow installed external provider light artifacts during audit to preserve runtime parity for custom configured credential fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Among the likely owners, this is the strongest available routing candidate for a permanent plugin/security boundary decision rather than a narrow implementation review.
